rule_en: Choose exactly one node from each group, three nodes total. This rule applies to all submissions.
render_required_en: Each node must include renders: at least one aerial and one eye-level render, plus a plan or section. Sequences, video and animation are encouraged.

nodes.brief_en: When labour is handed to machines and the commute no longer defines the day, how a dwelling is organised; residents, rotating staff and visitors living together.

nodes.en: A place for art and culture
nodes.brief_en: Desert, mountain, a dark night sky - a place people travel to: land art, a gallery, an observatory or a theatre.

nodes.en: Public space in heat and Zonda wind
nodes.brief_en: Under a 50 C ground surface and the Zonda, the square, market or garden people still choose to go out to.
nodes.zh: 酷热与风沙中的公共空间

nodes.brief_en: Take-off, landing, charging, sorting and maintenance for drones, and their relation to blocks and roofs; infrastructure and landmark at once.
How yards, the port of entry and automated sorting live with the city; what a hub looks like when freight has no driver.

nodes.en: A compute campus and its waste heat
nodes.brief_en: Compute halls or multiple campuses, substations, cooling, maintenance and credible heat users. Locate by power, water, cooling, transport, operational and safety conditions. A campus may be separate from housing and other nodes; waste-heat use requires justified temperature, distance and network assumptions, not forced adjacency.

The main entrance(s), regional approach and arrival sequence: how people, public transport, service and freight movements enter and separate, including public address, orientation and safe access. Identify existing versus proposed off-site links and unconfirmed rights; no regional road inside the site is implied. All schemes show main access in the whole-site plan; detailed entrance design is required only when C01 is selected.
nodes.brief_zh: 主入口、区域接入与到达序列：说明人、公共交通、服务与货运如何进入、分流，以及识别、导向和安全到达。区分既有与拟建的场外连接及未确认权利，不得暗示场内已有国道。所有方案须在全域规划中交代主要接入；选中C01时才要求入口节点详细设计。

nodes.en: The edge between agrivoltaic fields and the city
nodes.brief_en: The edge where power-above, planting-below land meets the city: interwoven, lifted, or a boundary you can walk along.
nodes.zh: 光伏农田与城市的边缘

nodes.brief_en: Dry most of the year, a flood channel in a storm. Whose it is the rest of the time, and how it becomes public space.

nodes.en: A street shared with driverless vehicles
nodes.brief_en: With driverless vehicles and robots on the road, how the street section, the crossing and a person's sense of safety are redesigned.
nodes.zh: 人与无人车共享的街道

rule_zh: 所有方案均须从三类节点中各选一处，共三处，完成详细设计并说明选择理由。
